sessions.charter: Explore the browser icon on every Prep Shop page with Chromium and inspect both icon formats to discover missing declarations, broken assets, or an incompatible legacy icon.
environments: Chromium on the local static server
notes: All six pages loaded with HTTP 200 and declared both the PNG favicon and the legacy ICO favicon.
The server returned HTTP 200 with image/png for /img/favicon.png and image/x-icon for /favicon.ico.
The PNG uses the existing kawaii basket illustration at 64x64; the ICO is a 32x32 32-bit Windows icon resource.
Chromium requested and loaded the PNG favicon on each visited page; the browser reported zero console errors or warnings.

notExplored: A legacy browser engine was unavailable; legacy compatibility was checked through the conventional ICO link, valid ICO binary structure, and successful local HTTP response rather than a live old-browser run.
